notes.title: 🌃 Early Access Has Begun! 🌃
notes.notes:
[p][b]Today, “Neon Village” has officially launched in Early Access on Steam! 🎉[/b]
[/p][p]To everyone who played the demo — thank you so much for your support. 🙏
Now, dive in and enjoy a [b]brand-new experience[/b] that combines roguelike strategy with match-3 puzzle excitement!
[/p][p]Thanks to your feedback, we’ve added new pieces, new buildings, and new features to make the game even more engaging.
[/p][p]During the Early Access period, we plan to keep expanding with [b]new pieces, new buildings, and even new biomes[/b].

We’d love to hear your feedback as we continue to improve the game, so please share your thoughts with us on [url="https://discord.gg/gCC23HnSvD" style="button"]Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Early Access Launch Date Announcement 🎉
notes.notes:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GqRGIhy8UbA"][/dynamiclink]────────────────────────────
[b]Release Date: Friday, August 29, 2025 – 2:00 AM PDT / 5:00 AM EDT[/b][/p][p][b]Other regions: CST 17:00 / BST 10:00[/b]
────────────────────────────[/p][p]The core gameplay experience is already complete, and from the very start of Early Access, you’ll be able to enjoy diverse strategies with [b]146 types of pieces[/b] and [b]84 types of buildings[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]While each run takes around 30 minutes in roguelike format, the pieces and buildings available will change depending on the biome, allowing for endless replayability.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, there’s still plenty we want to grow together with our players—such as balancing adjustments, expanded difficulty, and the addition of new pieces, buildings, and biomes.[/p][p]That’s why we’ve chosen to launch the game in Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Neon Village[/b][/i][b] is built on a highly polished foundation, but we want its future to be completed together with all of you.
[/b][/p][p]If you have any requests or feedback while playing, please post them freely on our [url="https://discord.gg/gCC23HnSvD" style="button"]Discord[/url].
We’d love to hear your voices.[/p][p][b]Let’s build [i]Neon Village[/i] together![/b][/p]

notes.title: New deck-building element "Buildings" added!
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo to version 0.6.0! Here are the details of the update:

[h3][New Features][/h3]
Added a new element, "Buildings," which supports deck building. Buildings add an extra layer of fun to deck building. They have effects just by possessing them, and you can obtain one each year after making a payment to the bank. Various buildings offer different effects, such as "Fishery" that assists fishermen and "Fruit Shop" that increases coin values from fruits. Make full use of buildings and explore your original deck building!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020742/d922cd7742b1ae47001748b06b77625ba3c5d3f5.png[/img]



[h3][Changes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the UI layout due to the addition of buildings.
[*] Reduced the maximum number of items that can be held from 9 to 8.
[*] Increased the number of coins needed for payments to the bank from the third year onward.
[*] Reduced the coins obtained from destroying acorns by squirrels from 3 to 2.
[*] Increased the number of pieces needed to qualify as an Engineer from 15 to 20.
[*] Changed the coins from the Jewelry Box from 1 to 2.
[*] Reduced the coins obtained when a large fish is destroyed from 5 to 3.
[*] Changed Father Petro's rarity from Epic to Legendary.
[*] Changed the rarity of the Safe from Legendary to Epic.
[*] Reduced the coins obtained when the Safe is destroyed from 100 to 50.
[/list]

Neon Village continues to evolve by listening to your feedback. If you have any comments or feedback, please feel free to post in the thread! We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Experience Neon Village!
notes.notes:
[h2][Demo Release] Experience "Neon Village" Firsthand![/h2]

The eagerly awaited demo of "Neon Village" is finally here, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the game's charm! This demo will be regularly updated leading up to the official release, with new content and features being added. We plan to keep everyone looking forward to it updated with the latest developments.


[h3][Upcoming Updates][/h3]

[list]
[*] Addition of a feature to display game completion time and date (for Time Attack mode)
[*] Introduction of a new feature "Buildings" to expand deck-building options
[*] Gamepad support
[*] Optimization of game balance
[/list]

"Neon Village" will continue to evolve with your feedback. Please add it to your wishlist and follow us for the latest updates. Let's energize the world of "Neon Village" together!
